reason: I need fixtures in hand within a week or two, and 10 to 12 business days for in-stock pieces (6 weeks if made to order) is too slow and too uncertain for my electrician date. On top of that, I've never heard of this store and $360 is a lot to risk on it.
objection: I can't tell when it will actually arrive, and I don't know this brand. If it's late or looks cheap in person, I'm stuck paying return shipping with my electrician date already passed.
would_change_my_mind: A guaranteed delivery date within about 7 days on in-stock pieces, plus free returns, or reviews from real buyers with photos showing the quality.
